tagline: A coastal contemporary masterpiece steps from La Jolla Cove, with sweeping Pacific views and refined interiors.
description: VA Approved! Fully Remodeled End Unit! Welcome to this beautifully remodeled 3bed, 2bath end unit home offering a bright, open floor plan designed for comfortable everyday living. The updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious living and dining areas, creating an inviting space for entertaining and relaxing. All 3 bedrooms are located upstairs, providing privacy from the main living area. Enjoy the convenience of an in home laundry area and your own private patio, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, or entertaining. This desirable end unit includes two assigned parking spaces. Enjoy a low HOA of just $300 per month, with access to a well maintained community pool and common areas. Move in ready and beautifully updated, this home is a fantastic opportunity you wont want to miss.
features: Chef's kitchen with Thermador appliances and quartzite counters
Primary suite with private ocean-view deck
Resort-style pool and built-in outdoor kitchen
Three-car attached garage with EV charging
Walking distance to La Jolla Cove and Village

description: Enjoy Gorgeous ocean view sunsets from this stunning two-story coastal retreat in the heart of Del Mar. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this beautiful home is ideally located near the Del Mar Village, world-renowned beaches, Torrey Pines Reserve, premier shopping and dining, and top-rated schools. The light-filled living room showcases spectacular ocean views and opens to an expansive deck, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor living experience. The gourmet kitchen and dining area also enjoy sweeping blue-water views and feature chef-quality appliances, a large center island, and elegant finishes. Rich wood flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by sophisticated stone and tile accents. Experience the best of Southern California coastal living and make the Del Mar dream your reality.
description_es: Disfrute de impresionantes puestas de sol frente al mar desde este magnífico refugio costero de dos plantas en el corazón de Del Mar. Con 3 recámaras y 3.5 baños, esta hermosa casa está idealmente ubicada cerca del Del Mar Village, playas de renombre mundial, la Reserva de Torrey Pines, centros comerciales y restaurantes de primer nivel, y escuelas de alta calificación. La sala iluminada exhibe espectaculares vistas al océano y se abre a una amplia terraza, creando la experiencia perfecta de vida interior-exterior. La cocina gourmet y el área de comedor también disfrutan de vistas panorámicas al mar, con electrodomésticos de nivel chef, una gran isla central y acabados elegantes. Pisos de madera rica fluyen por toda la casa, complementados por sofisticados detalles de piedra y azulejo. Viva lo mejor de la vida costera del sur de California y haga realidad el sueño de Del Mar.

A striking oversized glass pivot front door creates a grand and welcoming entrance. The kitchen is also equipped with a reverse osmosis water filtration system that delivers crisp, purified water directly at the tap. New white oak flooring flows gracefully throughout, complemented by a dramatic grand chandelier. A warm fireplace anchors the living room, creating an inviting gathering space for family and friends. description_es: Santuario Costero Magistralmente Renovado en las Prestigiosas Del Mar Heights | 5 Recámaras | 4 Baños. Enclavada en las prestigiosas Del Mar Heights, esta magistralmente renovada residencia encarna el lujo costero elevado para el comprador más exigente. Cada detalle fue cuidadosamente renovado: nuevo panel eléctrico, techo nuevo, pisos de roble blanco europeo y acabados interiores suaves que establecen un tono cálido y sofisticado. Una llamativa puerta pivotante de vidrio de gran tamaño crea una entrada imponente. Un ingeniero diseñó cuidadosamente el trazado, generando espacios bien definidos que fluyen perfectamente por toda la casa. El corazón del hogar es una cocina de inspiración gourmet con electrodomésticos Bosch premium, fregadero moderno sin contacto, gran isla central y despensa dedicada con vinoteca y fregadero. Los nuevos pisos de roble fluyen con gracia por toda la casa, complementados por una dramática araña. Una acogedora chimenea ancla la sala de estar. Nuevas puertas bi-fold de vidrio se abren dramáticamente al jardín, ofreciendo un verdadero estilo de vida indoor-outdoor perfecto para el café de la mañana, cenas al atardecer o entretenimiento relajado.

description: Perched in prestigious Del Mar Heights, this Masterfully reconstructed 5 bed, 5 bath residence of approximately 4,300 sq ft embodies elevated coastal luxury for the most discerning buyer. Every aspect has been thoughtfully renewed throughout this entire home renovation, from new windows, New plumbing, and electrical to smooth interior/exterior paint and European white oak wood flooring that sets a warm, sophisticated tone. The sculptural chef’s kitchen is anchored by Taj Mahal stone counters, massive island, white limestone wrapped pillars and feature wall, custom millwork, custom hood encompassed by Venetian plaster and a suite of Wolf and Zline appliances, flowing effortlessly into refined living and dining spaces oriented to capture tranquil ocean views. Designed for both intimate living and grand entertaining, the home offers a multimedia lounge, private gym, dry sauna, and a climate-controlled wine room. Walls of glass open to a resort-style backyard with a brand new pool, spa, porcelain pavers, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor experience. With designer finishes throughout and a flexible lower level designed for complete formal ADU, this is a rare opportunity to own a truly bespoke Del Mar estate. A true work of art!
description_es: Enclavada en las prestigiosas Del Mar Heights, esta magistralmente reconstruida residencia de 5 recámaras y 5 baños de aproximadamente 4,300 pies cuadrados encarna el lujo costero elevado. Cada aspecto fue cuidadosamente renovado: ventanas nuevas, plomería y electricidad nuevas, pintura interior/exterior lisa y pisos de roble blanco europeo que establecen un tono cálido y sofisticado. La escultural cocina de chef está anclada por encimeras de piedra Taj Mahal, una enorme isla central, columnas revestidas de piedra caliza blanca, carpintería personalizada, campana con yeso veneciano y electrodomésticos Wolf y Zline, fluyendo hacia refinadas áreas de sala y comedor con tranquilas vistas al océano. Diseñada para la vida íntima y el entretenimiento de gran escala, la casa ofrece sala multimedia, gimnasio privado, sauna seco y bodega con control climático. Paredes de vidrio se abren a un jardín resort con nueva piscina, spa, pisos de porcelana y cocina exterior totalmente equipada, creando una experiencia indoor-outdoor perfecta. Con acabados de diseñador y un nivel inferior flexible para ADU formal, esta es una oportunidad única de poseer una verdadera obra de arte en Del Mar.

description: This updated duplex features two identical detached units, each offering 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and approximately 950 sq. ft. of living space. Both units feature fresh interior and exterior paint, laminate wood flooring, dual-pane windows, blinds, and ceiling fans throughout. Inside, the inviting living rooms are highlighted by vaulted, wood-beamed ceilings that create a bright, open atmosphere. The kitchens include laminate countertops, stainless steel sinks, gas ranges with vent hoods, oak cabinetry, and spacious pantries, offering both functionality and everyday convenience. Each generously sized bedroom provides ample closet space and ceiling fans for added comfort. The bathrooms feature vanities, toilets, and glass-enclosed tub and shower combinations with a clean, practical design. Just off each kitchen is a dedicated utility room with laundry hookups and a water heater, adding convenience to each residence. Outside, each unit enjoys its own private fenced backyard, ideal for relaxing or outdoor use. Covered carports provide direct access to each residence, while additional side parking offers extra space for residents and guests. A standout investment feature is the separately metered gas, water, and electricity for each unit, allowing tenants to pay all utilities and helping reduce owner expenses. Conveniently located near shopping, schools, and everyday amenities, this duplex presents an excellent opportunity for investors or owner-occupants seeking two detached residences on one property. A versatile property offering privacy, convenience, plus rental appeal.
